About me

I'm Vasavi, a Bengaluru-based creator. I film what the city looks like when it comes alive: festivals, street food and late-night crowds.

I'm open to brand collaborations, event coverage and local city campaigns.

  • Short-form videoShot on location, handheld
  • On-screen text and captionsLocation pins, hooks and calls to action
  • Local storytellingFestivals, food and street culture
  • Audience2,000+ followers, reels up to 632K views
